title: Kazandibi Fettuccine
description: A deliciously simple Turkish dessert featuring delicate fettuccine, creamy milk, and a hint of rose water, reminiscent of traditional Kazandibi. Enjoy warm or chilled, as your heart desires.
instructions: Combine milk, cream, and vanilla extract in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce to low heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in rose water and sugar. Continue to simmer for another 2 minutes, or until the mixture thickens slightly.
Add the cooked fettuccine to the saucepan and toss to coat with the creamy mixture.
Transfer the fettuccine mixture to a serving dish and let cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight to allow the flavors to meld together.
Just before serving, garnish with chopped pistachios and a drizzle of honey, if desired.
Serve chilled or warm, topped with a dollop of whipped cream or a sprinkle of cinnamon, if preferred.
